purpose: Illustrative trajectory ending in a clear digit 2, as explicitly requested by the user.
selection_method: Visually inspected a contact sheet of saved final samples 0 through 99. Index 21 was the first clearly recognizable digit 2; selected for illustration before reproducing its intermediate frames.
interpretation: A visually selected example, not an unbiased sample or evidence of overall model quality.
display: Training-log normalization (mean 0.13142, standard deviation 0.30896), fixed [0,1] grayscale, white digits on black.
state_map_caveat: A digit-2-shaped Potts state and this trajectory are both from the same model. This selection does not establish that one displayed state alone generates the sample.
